notes:
Chat photos and Android Back fixes. The app-owned file picker gets a 60-second grace without showing the diary PIN. Media still pauses and screenshot protection stays on. Longer picker sessions, screen-off and phone lock still lock the app. A selected photo waits in memory until native and diary unlock are complete, then returns to the original draft. Cancel, navigation, reload or app destruction discards it.

Android system Back now follows in-app route history from Chat and other non-Home screens. A restored screen without earlier in-app history goes to Home, rather than closing the app. Chat contact info returns to Chat. Existing story/photo viewer Back behavior stays.

Same package and signing identity. Update without uninstalling. Friend mode, themes and private access rules are unchanged. Physical device picker/provider behavior may vary; a process restart cannot recover an unsubmitted selected photo.
